paite: Huan David sih ni ding ahong naita a; atapa Solomon thu apia hi.
heading: David In Solomon Athuhilhna Nanung

paite: "Leitung pumpi lampi ah ka pai sam dia; nang hattak leh pasalphatak in om in.

Na thilhih peuhmah leh na kiheina lam peuhmah a na lamzan theihna ding in Mosi Dan a gelh ahih bang in, TOUPA na Pathian in alampite zui ding leh adan thusehte, athupiakte, avaihawmte leh athu theihsakte pom dia thu apiakte zui in.

TOUPA'N ka tungtang thu a, 'Na suante'n alungtang tengteng uleh alungsimtak ua ka mitmuh a thutak a-om ding a, a-omdan ua apilvan uleh Israelte laltutphah a tu ding mi na tatlak kei ding, chi a agen ahihkip ding hi.’ ”

"Zeruiah tapa Joab in ahon bawldan, Israelte sepaih heutu nih Ner tapa Abner leh Jether tapa Amasa abawldan na thei hi. Amaute athah a, kilep lai a kidou sisan suah a, atai a kawnggak leh akhedap but a kidouna sisan abansakdan.
Huchi in pha na sakdan bang in hih inla, alu a kelsam pou in han ah lungmuangtak in tumsak ke'n.
Gilead mi Barzillai tapate tung ah hehpihna hihlang in. Na dohkan a an ummi ding in telsak in; na unau Absalom a pan ka taimang lai in ka kiang ah ahong ngal a.

Ngai in Bahurim mi, Benjamin suan Gera tapa Shimei na kiang ah a-om hi. Ama'n Mahanaim a ka hoh lai in hamse hoihloupi ahon lohkhum hi. Himahleh Jordan ah hong dawn ding in ahong kuan hi. Huai ah, namsau in ka hon that kei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou in akiang ah ka na kichiamta hi.
Huchi in moh lou in zaw koih ke'n; Mipil na hi ngal a. Atung ah bangchi in na hih dia chih ahihleh na thei mai ding. Alu a kelsam pou in sisan toh han ah na tumsak ding ahi," achi hi.
David bel apute kiang ah a-ihmu samta a, David khopi ah avui uhi.
heading: David Sihna

paite: Israelte tung a David lal sung kum sawmli ahi. Hebron ah kum sagih alal a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum alal hi.
Apa David laltutphah ah Solomon atu a; huchi in agam nakpitak a hihkip in ahong omta hi.
Huan Solomon nu Bathsheba kiang ah Haggith tapa Adonijah ahoh a. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu a hong na hi maw?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, "Hoih lam thu ah hi e,” achi hi.
heading: Adonijah Sihna

paite: "Na kiang ah banghiam gen ding ka nei hi," achi nawn a, ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.

Ama’n “Lalgam kei a ahita chih leh Israelte tengteng in leng kimpipa ding in kei ahon en gige uh chih na thei. Himahleh ka unaupa a ding in lalgam hei a om a, TOUPA sehdan in ka unaupa a ahong hita hi.
Tu in thil khat nget ding ka hon nei a, hon nial ke’n,” ahi hi. Ama’n akiang ah, “Gen ve.” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Hehpih in kumpipa Solomon hon houpihsak inla, na thu sel lou ding ahi ngal a, Shunam mi Abishag zi ding in hon neisak in," achi hi.
Bathsheba in, "Hileh ake, kumpipa ka hon na houpihsak ding," achi hi.

Bathsheba in Adonijah a dia kumpipa Solomon houpih ding in akiang ah ahohta hi. Amah mu ding in kumpipa adingh a, ama ah akun a, alaltutphah ah atuta hi. Kumpipa nu a ding in laltutphah akoihsak a; ataklam ah atu hi.
"Thil neuchik khat ka hon ngen ut hi. Hon nial mahmah ke'n," achi hi. Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Nu, hon ngen ve, ka hon phalsak lou kei ding," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Shunam mi Abishag na unaupa Adonijah zi ding in neisak in," achi hi.

Kumpipa Solomon in adawng a, anu kiang ah, "Bangchidan a Shunam mi Abishag, Adonijah a dia ngen na hia oi? Gam leng ngetsak vanglak tanla; amah ka u avo oi. Amah a ding leh siampu Abiathar leh Zeruiah tapa Joab a ding in leng ngen tanla," achi hi.
Kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA min lou in, "Adonijah thilnget in amah tung a sihna thu gen ahih kei himhimleh Pathian in alohloh in hon loh mai hen, huai sang a thupizaw in leng.
TOUPA, athuchiam bang a hon hihkip, ka pa David laltutphah a hon tusak, inkuan hon na phuhkhiaksakpa ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Adonijah tuni mahmah a asihsak ngeingei ding ahi," chi in akichiamta hi.
Huchi in kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah asawl a, ama'n ava sual a, athatta hi.

Siampu Abiathar kiang ah kumpipa'n, "Anathoth a na inn-le-lou ah pai in, si tak lah na hi ngal a. Himahleh ka pa David ma a Toupa PATHIAN bawm na na zawn zel ziak in leh ka pa haksatna thuak tengteng na na thuak sam zel ziak in, tu in zaw ka hon that kei ding,” achi hi.
heading: Abiathar Hawlmangna Leh Joab Sihna

paite: Huchi in Solomon in Abiathar TOUPA siampu ahihna atawpsak hi. Hiai TOUPA'N Shiloh a Eli inkuante tungtang thu agen atangtun theihna ding ahi.
Huai thu Joab kiang ahong tung a, Absalom lam ah Joab apang kei na a, Adonijah lam ah apang hi. Joab TOUPA puanin ah atai a, maitam kiite alen hi.
"TOUPA puanin ah Joab atai a, ngai in, maitam bul ah a-om," chi in kumpipa Solomon ahilh uhi. Kumpipa Solomon in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah, va sual in, chi in asawl hi.

Benaiah TOUPA puanin ah ahohtou a, akiang ah, "Kumpipa'n hong pawtkhia heh, achi,” achi hi. Ama'n, "Hilou e. Hiai ah ka si zaw ding,” achi hi. Benaiah in, “Joab in huchi in ahon na dawng hi,” chi in kumpipa kiang ah thu atun nawn hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Achih bang in hih inla, va sual inla, vui in, aziak om het lou a Joab in sisan asuahna a pan kei leh ka pa inkote na hulsak theihna ding in," achi hi.

"Amah sang a kizenzaw leh hoihzaw mi nih, Ner tapa Abner, Israelte sepaih heutu leh Jether tapa Amasa, Judahte sepaih heutu ka pa David theih louh a sual a, namsau a athah ziak in TOUPA'N alutung ah asisan akiksak nawn ding hi.

Huaiziak in asisan uh Joab lutung leh asuante lutung ah tangtawn in akik nawn dia; David leh asuante leh a-inkote leh alaltutphah tung ah TOUPA a pan lungmuanna tangtawn in a-om nilouh ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah va hohtou in ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gamdai ah amah inn mah ah vui in a-om hi.
heading: Shimei Sihna

paite: Kumpipa'n sepaihte tung ah asik in Jehoiada tapa Benaiah apangsak hi. Kumpipa'n Abiathar sik in Siampu Zadok apangsak hi.
Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Jerusalem ah inn kilam inla huai ah teng inla, huai a pan koi dang mah ah pawt ke'n.
Na pawt ni, Kidron lui na kan ni in na si ngeingei ding chỉh thei in. Na sisan nangmah lutung mah ah a-om ding," achi hi.
Shimei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Adik hi. TOUPA ka kumpipa'n agen bang in na sikha in ahih zel ding," achi hi. Huchi in Jerusalem ah Shimei sawtkuamtak ateng hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, kum thum nung in Shimei sikhate lak a nih, Gath kumpipa Maakah tapa Akish kiang ah ataimang uhi. "Ngai in, na sikhate Gath ah a-om uh," chi in Shimei ahilh uhi.
Shimei athou a, asabiltung avan a, asikhate zong ding in Gath a Akish kiang ah ahohta hi. Shimei in Gath a pan asikhate ava pikik hi.
Shimei Jerusalem a pan apawt a, Gath ah hoh in ahong kik nawn chi in Solomon ahilh uhi.

Kumpipa'n Shimei asamsak a, akiang ah, "Na pawt ni, gamdang a na pawtkhiak ni in na si ngeingei ding, chi in TOUPA min lou a hon kichiamsak in, ka hon theisak ahi kei maw? Nangmah in leng ka kiang ah, na thugen ka zak ahoih hi, na chi hi.
Bangziak a TOUPA kichiamna leh ka hon thupiak zui lou na hia?" achi hi.
Kumpipa mah in Shimei kiang ah, "Na lungtang sunggil gitlouhdan, ka pa David tung a na gamtatdante na thei vek hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N na gitlouhna nangmah lutung ngei ah akiksak nawn ding.
Kumpipa Solomon vualzawl in a-om dia, David laltutphah TOUPA ma ah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding,” achi hi.
Huchi in kumpipa'n Jehoiada tapa Benaiah thu apia hi. Amah akuan a, ava sual a, athatta hi. Huchi in gam Solomon khut a hihkip in a-omta hi.
